entries.title: Crema · Tasting Counter
entries.description: A travertine tasting counter with a porcelain cup and saucer, milk pitcher and coffee scale. Four original bar lights model the materials in a close three-quarter view.

entries.title: Motus · Training Bay
entries.description: A lifting bench, studio mat and kettlebell arranged against walnut acoustic ribs and an architectural plaster wall. Four original studio lights shape the training bay.
